Donald John Trump (born June 14, 1946) is the 45th and current President of the United States. Before entering politics, he was a businessman and television personality.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Trump was born and raised in the New York City borough of Queens. He received an economics degree from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and was appointed president of his family's real estate business in 1971, renamed it The Trump Organization, and expanded it from Queens and Brooklyn into Manhattan. The company built or renovated skyscrapers, hotels, casinos, and golf courses. Trump later started various side ventures, including licensing his name for real estate and consumer products. He managed the company until his 2017 inauguration. He co-authored several books, including The Art of the Deal. He owned the Miss Universe and Miss USA beauty pageants from 1996 to 2015, and he produced and hosted the reality television show The Apprentice from 2003 to 2015. Forbes estimates his net worth to be $3.1 billion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Trump entered the 2016 presidential race as a Republican and defeated sixteen opponents in the primaries. Commentators described his political positions as populist, protectionist, and nationalist. His campaign received extensive free media coverage; many of his public statements were controversial or false. Trump was elected president in a surprise victory over Democratic nominee Hillary Clinton. He became the oldest and wealthiest person ever to assume the presidency, the first without prior military or government service, and the fifth to have won the election while losing the popular vote. His election and policies have sparked numerous protests. Many of his comments and actions have been perceived as racially charged or racist.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]During his presidency, Trump ordered a travel ban on citizens from several Muslim-majority countries, citing security concerns; after legal challenges, the Supreme Court upheld the policy's third revision. He signed tax cut legislation which cut tax rates for individuals and businesses and also rescinded the individual insurance mandate provision of the Affordable Care Act and opened the Arctic Refuge for oil drilling. He enacted a partial repeal of the Dodd-Frank Act that had imposed stricter constraints on banks in the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis. He pursued his America First agenda in foreign policy, withdrawing the U.S. from the Trans-Pacific Partnership trade negotiations, the Paris Agreement on climate change, and the Iran nuclear deal. He recognized Jerusalem as the capital of Israel, imposed import tariffs on various goods, triggering a trade war with China, and negotiated with North Korea with the aim of denuclearization. He nominated two justices to the Supreme Court, Neil Gorsuch and Brett Kavanaugh.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]After Trump dismissed FBI Director James Comey, the Justice Department appointed Robert Mueller as Special Counsel to investigate "any links and/or coordination" between the Trump campaign and the Russian government in its election interference. Trump has repeatedly denied accusations of collusion and obstruction of justice, calling the investigation a politically motivated "witch hunt".
Trump prides the American nation and its people. His people are hard working so long as their jobs are free and American.

Early in the game, the American advantage is its cheaper Civilian purchases in loyal cities. They will want to keep their cities connected via domestic trade routes if they want to maintain this advantage. They should also consider building toward the National History Museum in their Government Plaza. With their Film Studio, National Park bonus, and two post-Industrial unique units, they shine from the 20th Century onwards.

Supercarrier

American unique Atomic era naval unit that replaces the Aircraft Carrier when Donald Trump is their leader. Can enter foreign territory without an Open Borders agreement and generates Influence toward an [ICON_ENVOY] Envoy whilst stationed outside American borders so long as America is at peace. Costs additional Maintenance.

The appellation "supercarrier" is not an official designation with any national navy, but a term used predominantly by the media and typically when reporting on new and upcoming aircraft carrier types. It is also used when comparing carriers of various sizes and capabilities, both current and past. It was first used by The New York Times in 1938, in an article about the Royal Navy's HMS Ark Royal, that had a length of 209 metres (686 ft), a displacement of 22,000 tonnes and was designed to carry 72 aircraft. Since then, aircraft carriers have consistently grown in size, both in length and displacement, as well as improved capabilities; in defense, sensors, electronic warfare, propulsion, range, launch and recovery systems, number and types of aircraft carried and number of sorties flown per day.

唐纳德·约翰·特朗普（生于1946年6月14日）是美国第45任现任总统。在进入政界之前，他是一名商人和电视名人。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特朗普在纽约市皇后区出生并长大。他获得了宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院的经济学学位，并于1971年被任命为其家族房地产业务的总裁，将其更名为特朗普集团，并将其从皇后区和布鲁克林扩展到曼哈顿。该公司建造或翻新了摩天大楼、酒店、赌场和高尔夫球场。特朗普后来开始了各种副业，包括授权其名字用于房地产和消费品。他一直管理公司直到2017年就职。他合著了几本书，包括《交易的艺术》。从1996年到2015年，他拥有环球小姐和美国小姐选美大赛的主办权，并从2003年到2015年制作并主持了真人秀电视节目《学徒》。福布斯估计他的净资产为31亿美元。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特朗普以共和党人身份参加了2016年总统竞选，并在初选中击败了十六位对手。评论员将他的政治立场描述为民粹主义、保护主义和民族主义。他的竞选活动获得了广泛的免费媒体报道；他的许多公开言论具有争议性或虚假性。特朗普在意外击败民主党候选人希拉里·克林顿后当选总统。他成为有史以来上任时年龄最大、最富有的人，第一位没有军队或政府服务经验的人，也是第五位在输掉普选的情况下赢得选举的人。他的当选和政策引发了众多抗议活动。他的许多言论和行为被视为带有种族主义色彩或种族主义。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在总统任期内，特朗普以安全担忧为由，下令对来自几个穆斯林占多数的国家的公民实施旅行禁令；经过法律挑战后，最高法院维持了该政策的第三个修订版。他签署了减税立法，降低了个人的税率和企业税，并废除了《平价医疗法案》的个人保险强制条款，并开放北极保护区进行石油钻探。他部分废除了在2008年金融危机后对银行实施更严格约束的《多德-弗兰克法案》。他在外交政策上推行其“美国优先”议程，退出《跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》贸易谈判、《巴黎气候协定》和伊朗核协议。他承认耶路撒冷为以色列首都，对各种商品加征进口关税，引发与中国的贸易战，并与朝鲜进行旨在实现无核化的谈判。他提名了两位最高法院大法官，尼尔·戈萨奇和布雷特·卡瓦诺。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]在特朗普解雇联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米后，司法部任命罗伯特·穆勒为特别检察官，调查特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯政府在其选举干预中的“任何联系和/或协调”。特朗普一再否认共谋和妨碍司法的指控，称这项调查是出于政治动机的“政治迫害”。

超级航母
美国原子能时代特色海军单位，在唐纳德·特朗普担任领袖时取代航空母舰。无需开放边界协议即可进入外国领土，只要美国处于和平状态，驻扎在境外时即可产生获得1位[ICON_ENVOY] 使者的影响力。维护费用更高。

“超级航母”这个称谓并非任何国家海军的官方名称，而是一个主要由媒体使用的术语，通常在报道新型和即将问世的航空母舰类型时使用。在比较各种规模和能力的现役及过往航母时也会使用该词。它于1938年由《纽约时报》首次使用，用于报道英国皇家海军的皇家方舟号（HMS Ark Royal），该舰长209米（686英尺），排水量22,000吨，设计搭载72架飞机。此后，航空母舰的尺寸（包括长度和排水量）持续增长，能力也不断提升；包括防御、传感器、电子战、推进、航程、起飞和回收系统、搭载飞机的数量和类型以及每日出动架次。
